candidates.change_summary: Replace depositsCount++ with depositsCount-- so that receive() decrements instead of incrementing depositsCount.
Replace require(((depositsCount + 1) >= depositsCount)) with require(false) so that receive() always reverts.
Delete depositsCount++ so that receive() accepts Ether but never updates depositsCount.
Delete the require statement so that receive() always succeeds and increments depositsCount.
Delete the entire body of withdrawAll to prevent any ether transfer, making the contract balance remain unchanged.
Replace the withdraw call with a call that transfers 0 wei, so the balance is not pulled to zero.
Insert a pre-decrement of depositsCount before the withdraw, which may cause revert and prevent the transfer, changing the final balance.
Replace the withdraw parameter with a hardcoded small value, preventing full balance withdrawal.
Delete the entire modifier body so that onlyOwner no longer checks the caller, allowing anyone to call withdrawAll.
Replace the require with a tautology (true), removing the owner check so anyone can call withdrawAll.
Delete the transfer statement so withdraw sends nothing.
Replace transfer with call, which may not revert on failure, changing the contract's balance after withdraw.
Delete the require statement in onlyOwner so anyone can call withdraw.
